spec.prompt: During a total solar eclipse, on a riverbank, Thales of Miletus, the man from reference image 1 (about 40, lean, dark hair knotted at the nape under a braided fillet, short pointed beard with a shaved upper lip, crinkled off-white linen chiton, terracotta-red wool mantle over the left shoulder, leather sandals, a tall wooden staff in his hand), walks slowly toward the camera between warriors frozen like statues mid-battle: Lydians like reference image 2 (crested bronze helmets, crimson tunics, lion shields) and Medes like reference image 3 (red felt caps, ochre tunics, wicker shields), caught mid-strike and completely motionless. He is the only thing that moves: calm, unhurried steps, head tilted back, looking up at the sky with quiet curiosity, his mantle swaying. Readable dusk light of a total eclipse: dim, even twilight, an orange glow low along the horizon, every face and costume still clearly readable. No fog, no smoke. He is lit a little warmer than the frozen men. Camera: slow, steady tracking shot moving backward in front of him at chest height. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. Reference images are identity, costume and location references only: never show the grey studio, the turnaround layout or the inset panels. No text, no watermark.
spec.notes: The only living thing walks between the statues (painted in colour by the renderer).
